name: role-administration-allowed
reason: Reading and editing the role catalogue is what administering a realm consists of.

name: role-change-denied
reason: Editing what a role grants is withheld while this policy stands, whatever else allows it. Withdraw the policy deliberately, so widening the authority is a decision somebody made rather than one nobody noticed.

name: session-review-allowed-at-elevated-assurance
reason: Reading where an account is signed in is offered once the sign-in itself reached a second factor.

name: sensitive-transaction-view-requires-elevated-assurance
reason: The role already gates this behind an elevation; the condition is a second, independent check that the sign-in itself also reached a second factor, on a business resource rather than on the authority's own.
